meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. An apology for the phone call doesn't take the zero off. Was Owen heard before that mark went in, yes or no?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, when, and under which section of your own procedure, because 4.5 is for repeated concerns and this is a first. It comes off his file today, Hale. If it doesn't, I'm in the principal's office tonight and at the board after that.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
"Just a note." Nothing goes on Owen's record, Hale, not a note, not a word. Who wrote it, and when?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that the note placed in his student file be removed, and an apology for how this was handled. As I said in the meeting, that note comes off his file today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, the note removed from Owen's file, and an apology, and this is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, because no evidence about the essay was ever put in front of her.
What moved her: Nothing; owning the missed phone call earned a flat acknowledgement, but without a dated, checkable document she had no reason to give ground.
What cost ground: Saying the concern was already in his student file and then calling it a note that means nothing, because that hit her one non-negotiable and the procedure only allows file notes for repeated concerns.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night because no evidence about the essay was shown; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether Owen was heard before the mark went in, answer that directly and follow with a dated document tied to his essay that she can check herself, instead of raising the note in his file.
